messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up on the compact-affinity fallback slab idea I posted in the RFC — TL;DR: group tenants into compact slabs by affinity to reduce fanout when soft-fallbacks trigger.
kevin: can you sketch the runtime change? how do slabs differ from current bucketized weights?
sophia: slabs are contiguous affinity ranges with a tiny override table. runtime keeps a per-route slab index (O(1) lookup). on fallback we probe slab neighbors instead of scoring the whole candidate set, so fewer model hops and less KV churn.
omar: sounds promising for tail latency, but worried about fairness — would tenants at slab edges consistently get worse choices? :thinking:
sophia: good call. plan: randomize slab offsets per epoch and rotate slab assignment on a long cadence (configurable) to avoid long-lived edge bias. also add per-tenant decay so hot tenants don't hog a slab forever.
rachel: what about cache invalidation and KV prefix caching? moving tenants between slabs could blow cached prefixes.
sophia: we only reassign at epoch boundaries and annotate cache keys with slab-gen metadata. eviction is batched at the slab-gen boundary. expected extra miss-rate in worst-case sim ~2-4%. we propose sticky slab-gen per session for 1h to smooth transitions.
kevin: show a minimal config snippet to understand knobs
sophia: ```
route_policies:
  /chat/compose:
    fallback: compact_slab
    slab_size: 128          # tenants per slab
    rotation_secs: 3600     # epoch rotation
    neighbor_probe: 2       # how many adjacent slabs to probe on miss
    slab_gen_sticky_secs: 3600  # session stickiness to avoid cache churn
```
kevin: nice. how do we detect when compact_slab is hurting availability vs helping cost? metrics?
sophia: metrics we care about: probe_success_rate (how often neighbor probe finds a compatible slot), extra_cache_miss_rate, p99_latency_by_tenant, routing_fanout_size. proposed SLO: probe_success_rate >= 90% and extra_cache_miss_rate < 5% during canary.
omar: rollout plan? simulations first?
sophia: yes — three phases: 1) sim with historical traces + synthetic spike tests, 2) internal sandbox canary against non-critical routes, 3) progressive canary by region with kill-switch. add feature flag `compact_slab.enabled` per route.
deploy-bot: Checklist: add feature flag, telemetry hooks for the metrics above, canary thresholds, and a config toggle to disable rotation for debugging.
rachel: one last operational nit: tie-breakers when neighbor slabs are full. prefer lower-cost model under a cost cap, otherwise fall back to regional shard. document this in the RFC patch.
sophia: agreed — patch will include tie-breaker order: (1) neighbor slab compatible slot, (2) same-region lower-cost model under cost_cap, (3) cross-region degrade with notification. will update RFC and add simulation config. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
